topics.hierarchy: Hierarchy: Supreme Court (Delhi) → High Court (state) → District Court → Magistrate. Lok Adalat for settlement.
topics.process: Court process: File case → Notice → Reply → Evidence → Arguments → Judgment → Appeal. Civil cases take 2-5 years average, criminal longer. Mediation faster.
topics.bail: Bail: Bailable offense = easy bail at police station. Non-bailable = need court. Anticipatory bail before arrest if fear.
